bugLogs.title: Insufficient color contrast for hint text on checkout payment page
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the paragraph with class "hint" that reads "We never store your card details"
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The paragraph uses color #c4c4c4 on a white background (#ffffff), resulting in a contrast ratio of 1.74:1, which fails WCAG 1.4.3.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for p, change color from #c4c4c4 to #767676 (4.54:1 on #ffffff; measured 1.74:1, required 4.5:1).

_severity_override.rule: CLAUDE.md: checkout flow violations are always critical

bugLogs.title: Pay Now image button missing accessible name
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the Pay Now button rendered as <input type="image" src="pay-now.png">
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The image button must have a text alternative that conveys its purpose (e.g., "Pay now") via alt, aria-label, title, or an associated label.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The <input type="image"> element has no alt attribute, no aria-label, no aria-labelledby, no title, and no associated label, providing no accessible name.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add an accessible name, for example: <input type="image" src="pay-now.png" alt="Pay now" width="120" height="40"> or add aria-label="Pay now" if alt cannot be used.

bugLogs.title: Select element #promo lacks an accessible name
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The select control must have a programmatically determinable name so that assistive technologies can announce its purpose (e.g., "Promo code").
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The <select id="promo"> element has no associated <label>, no aria-label, no aria-labelledby, and no title attribute, resulting in no accessible name.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a visible label and associate it with the select, e.g., <label for="promo">Promo code</label> before the <select>, or add aria-label="Promo code" to the select element.

bugLogs.title: Missing persistent labels for payment form fields
steps_to_reproduce: Focus on the input with id="pay-name"
Observe that only placeholder text "Name on card" is announced
Repeat for the input with id="pay-card"
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Each form input must have a persistent visible label (or an accessible name via aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title) that is announced by screen readers and remains visible when the user types.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The inputs #pay-name and #pay-card rely solely on placeholder text for identification; no <label>, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title is provided.
bugLogs.suggested_fix:
Add a <label> element associated with each input and remove reliance on placeholder as the sole label. Example:

<label for="pay-name" class="sr-only">Name on card</label>
<input type="text" id="pay-name" placeholder="Name on card" aria-required="true">

<label for="pay-card" class="sr-only">Card number</label>
<input type="text" id="pay-card" placeholder="Card number" aria-required="true">

_severity_override.rule: CLAUDE.md: checkout flow violations are always critical
